articles.title: Dallas AI Startup 4Minds Raises $15M Series A at $500M Valuation
articles.summary: Dallas-based AI startup 4Minds, which emerged from stealth mode in April, is already halfway to unicorn status. The company said today that it has raised a $15 million Series A round at a $500 million post-money valuation. Investors include Dallas-based Waterwood Capital Group and Lubbock-based Isom Holdings — both led in part by Clayton Isom, whose family founded Wichita Falls-based oil and gas management company Stephens & Johnson in the 1960s — and several family offices with ties to the energy and data center industries. …

articles.title: Dallas Startup Optimus OS Develops Wearable Tech to Combat Veterans’ Health Issues
articles.summary: A Dallas startup is launching pilot tests this month of wearable medical devices designed to benefit military veterans and first responders. Optimus OS pairs wearable biosensor technology with AI-powered analytics to address mental and physical health care needs of veterans, police officers, firefighters and others. …
